title: Cross the River to Triana!
text: Superb Tour of Triana. Seville Guias & Tours tailored a custom private tour of Triana for my wife and me.  Julio was very knowledgeable of the area, its interests, and sights, bringing alive the areas links to bullfighting, the discovery of the Americas, fishing, and Catholic faith.  The roots of the Inquisition were explained in detail at the site of the former castle/prison. Julio and Seville Guias & Tours also arranged an authentic Flamenco dinner at Pura Esencia in Triana, with no more than about 18 people in a tiny cafe/stage.  You're right in the action.  The music, singing, and dancing
author: Coombsjl
